prompt: A diazonium salt (ArN₂⁺) can be converted to which of these ArX groups?

options.label: Cl, Br, CN, OH, H, and F — via different reagents (CuX, H₂O, H₃PO₂, HBF₄)
Only Cl and Br (via Sandmeyer with CuCl/CuBr) — nothing else works
Cl, Br, CN, OH, H — but NOT F (no good diazonium → ArF method exists)
Cl, Br, CN, OH, F — but NOT H (removing an aryl group is impossible)

explanation: ArN₂⁺ is enormously versatile: CuCl → ArCl, CuBr → ArBr, CuCN → ArCN (Sandmeyer); HBF₄ then heat → ArF (Schiemann); H₃PO₂ → ArH (reductive dediazonation, strips N₂ with H); H₂O/heat → ArOH. All six are standard.
